translation_notes: RDF and RDFS are module-level `from rdflib import RDF, RDFS`, so their @prefix stays at module scope; the region under study is LDP and XHV, both `Namespace(...)` calls INSIDE the function body, translated to `@prefix ldp:`/`@prefix xhv:` at that exact point, in the function's block scope (declarations.md's block-scope rule).

consolidated each run of g.add(...) sharing a subject into one +{ s p1 o1 ; p2 o2 } (migrate-from-rdflib.md); left the conditional prev/next and parent-label adds as separate +{ } since they are not on the same control-flow path as the block they'd otherwise join.

dropped the explicit Literal(...) wrapper where the default coercion already produces the same term (plain string -> plain literal); kept Literal(self.comment, lang='en') as {self.comment}@en, the interpolation + glued suffix form, rather than wrapping the whole Literal(...) call opaquely in {}.
RDF.Bag is used as a PREDICATE in the source (`g.add((parent_uri, RDF.Bag, u))`), not a typo I fixed: kept verbatim as `rdf:Bag` in predicate position, no refactor.

fixture self is a types.SimpleNamespace, not a plain class: the harness compares call arguments after the call too (mutation check), and SimpleNamespace's structural __eq__ is what makes two separately-constructed fixtures (one per side) compare equal.

Repair 2026-11-02 (ldpy 0.7.1): an interpolated None now raises, and call[4] hands the region label=None. The original `Literal(self.label)` writes the literal "None" (a probable upstream bug, kept as is), so the faithful translation writes `rdfs:label {Literal(self.label)}`, and only there; the notation is kept for the other terms (a None comment or member title is not exercised and still raises in the island, unlike the original). Proof: check OK; the bare `{self.label}` makes call[4] FAIL (TypeError vs graph).

mutants_killed: `{Literal(self.label)}` -> `{self.label}` (call[4]: TypeError vs graph with the literal "None")
repair.remaining: The original writes the literal "None" for a None label (upstream bug kept as is); a None comment or member title would also write "None" in the original and raise in the translation, but no driver call nor repository path produces one.

previous.driver: six appels ajoutés (1 seul auparavant) : page 1 sur 1 sans membre, sans parent ni paramètre de requête (branche other_qsas_str = '') ; page = last_page avec un parent sans label et page/per_page filtrés parmi les paramètres ; la forme ContainerOfContainersRenderer (lignes SPARQL (URIRef, Literal@en) et (URIRef, Literal typé), parent None) ; un tuple à trois éléments, un title int, label None et comment int ; label et comment déjà Literal (@fr re-étiqueté @en, typé) ; un membre chaîne contenant « uri » (TypeError comparée par type et message). Et une comparaison des liaisons de préfixes (le dépôt sérialise ce graphe via _make_rdf_response) : chaque liaison posée par le graphe de l'original doit se retrouver dans celui de la traduction, liaisons en plus tolérées, fusionnée dans le verdict de run_pair.
mutants_killed: préfixe ldp: renommé ldpx: (liaison perdue, triplets identiques)
garde `if self.parent_container_label is not None` -> `if True`
label du membre tuple `{member[1]}` -> `{str(member[1])}` (Literal typé de la ligne SPARQL perdu)

Un écart hors des entrées documentées : si un label (member[1], member["title"], label, parent_container_label) est un URIRef ou un BNode, Literal(x) en fait un littéral et {x} le garde tel quel ; seul un cofc.ttl dont rdfs:label a une IRI pour valeur l'atteindrait (ContainerOfContainersRenderer, renderer_container.py:393), la docstring du dépôt dit « string elements ». optimization_notes: optimized.py: the three branches of the member loop share one `g.add((u, RDFS.member, member_uri))` after the if/elif/else (the bare-string branch sets `member_uri = URIRef(member)`); the query-string list, its `len` test and the two-branch `other_qsas_str` become one `"".join(x + "=" + v + "&" ...)` over `query_params.items()` (joining with "&" and appending "&" is the same as suffixing each item); `page_uri_str` goes (`page_uri_str_nonum + str(self.page)` is the same text); the three triples on `u`, the four on `page_uri` and the two on the parent become `g += [...]`; `parent_uri` names the parent IRI built three times. The `"uri" in member` test is kept as is, including its TypeError on a bare string containing "uri" (call 6). g is local, so a raise loses the partial graph on both sides as in the original.

optimized.ldpy, from optimized.py: LDP/XHV and their bind calls become `@prefix ldp:`/`@prefix xhv:` followed by `@graph g` (checked by hand that every binding of the original graph survives in the four new artefacts: the driver's binding check reads translated.ldpy only); every `URIRef(...)` becomes `f<...>` (no @base in scope), including `f<{page_uri_str_nonum}{self.page - 1}>` for the concatenations; seven `+{ }` with `a`, prefixed names and `{self.comment}@en`. As in the faithful translation, `{Literal(self.label)}` stays because a None label must give the literal "None" (call 4), while a None comment or member title would raise in the island (not exercised, inherited from the translation). No exception to the symmetry rule.
header_optimization_notes: optimized_header.py: every name of `from rdflib import Graph, Namespace, URIRef, Literal, RDF, RDFS` is used: a copy of optimized.py.
optimized_header.ldpy: URIRef goes (every IRI is an `f<...>`); Graph and Literal stay, and the two `@prefix rdf:`/`rdfs:` lines are used.
